flaws.description: Changed the y-axis label from 'Density' to 'Population Percentage (%)', which names a different quantity than the KDE's probability density.

Swapped the Country labels in the data dict (Kenya now labels the first 50 high-income rows and Dominican Republic the last 50 low-income rows), so the legend/hue names no longer match the underlying income distributions while colors (assigned alphabetically by hue) stay the same.
